context: Asuka lectures on treaties and resources.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: economics lecture; vocabulary (協定/同意/保有/全面/変動) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 協定は、国同士の同意で成り立ちます。
lines.en: Agreements rest on consent between nations.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 全面的な同意は、難しいんですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 全面の同意には、長い交渉が要ります。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 資源の保有が、関係しますか?
lines.en: Do resource holdings relate to it?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 保有量の差が、交渉を難しくします。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 価格の変動も、影響しますか?
lines.en: Do price fluctuations affect it too?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 変動が大きいと、協定が揺らぎます。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 協定の難しさ、よく分かりました。
lines.en: I understand the difficulty of agreements.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
